overview_description.description:
3Dmena specialized in building fabrication laboratories (“FabLabs”) and operate them as training centers and hardware business incubators, intended to address not only the challenges in the world today, but also to prepare the region starting from Jordan for a rapidly changing job market shaped by emerging technology. Since inception, 3Dmena advocated for 3D printing technology adoption in Jordan and introduced the concept of Fab Labs to Jordan In partnership and support from NextFab, Luminus Group & Fab Foundation.

In May 2017 3Dmena team and assets merged under Luminus Education focusing on the sustainability of Shamal Start project.
